draft_content:
R.I.P. the 40-tab spreadsheet. It’s time to retire the manual coordination of multi-supplier quotes.

I’ve spent years watching travel agencies drown in fragmented WhatsApp threads and email chains.

Every itinerary update triggers a cascade of copy-paste errors. A single typo in a hotel confirmation can cost a boutique agency its margin and its reputation.

This is the unglamorous reality of B2B travel tech. It isn’t about flashy AI features. It’s about eliminating the operational friction that keeps specialists stuck in data entry.

We built Viato to centralize customer preferences, supplier communications, and dynamic booking updates into one structured workflow.

The goal is simple: give travel specialists enterprise-grade efficiency without forcing them to learn complex ERP systems.

When you remove the chaos of manual spreadsheets, you free up human judgment for what matters: crafting the perfect trip.

How are you currently handling the disconnect between supplier updates and client itineraries? What’s the biggest bottleneck in your booking workflow?
